text_block_list.text:
The "Japan Dirt Derby" was about to begin.
Leaving summer training camp behind, we arrived at Oi Racecourse to find it packed with people.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy~!
Don't bite anyone today~~!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I'd really love to see her flub a line
live in person at least once, though~!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Nnnrgh!
I instructed Shinko Windy not to let hecklers goad her into saying anything unnecessary.
choice_data_list: (I can't afford to lose focus right now.)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: (Daaang it! Gotta endure it, I just gotta endure it...)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
(...Today is the day I show everyone in the world
how cool I can be...!)

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: —Haa, haa...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Dammit... My time isn't improving at all...
I'm just getting worse and worse...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Won't give up... I won't give up...
Give... up...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"...Is this as far as I go?
I mean, after trying this hard, I still can't win..."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I can't become a hero after all...?
Would it be better if I just gracefully retired—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Is it that time already?
Windy-senpai's race is about to start..."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Windy-chan in a GⅠ, huh...
She won't cause any trouble again, will she...?"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
I know you're worried, but let's cheer for them!
...Ah, Biko-chan! Wanna watch together?
The next one's titled 'Voices from the Crowd'!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! I doubt she'd mess up in a GⅠ race, but... it'd be hilarious if she did!
I'm expecting big things in all sorts of ways! Gwahaha!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Are they really reflecting on their actions?
There's been zero explanation since then,
and their Umatter has gone completely silent too...

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
It's scary~, just thinking about my favorite getting bitten.
I really wish they wouldn't sully a sacred race like that.
Everyone takes it far too lightly.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I get it, but............
I get it, but still............!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Over just one incident...
Do people really have to keep bringing it up this much...?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
......Hmph.
Windy-chan won't lose
to a little headwind like this!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I've got... an ambition, you know...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Windy-senpai is calm even in the paddock, huh...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Even with people heckling her, she didn't lose heart at all...
She just stood there, looking so dignified...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: There's no way... it isn't painful, and yet...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Just what kind of run...
will she show us...?
